Use case would be to distinguish `BlobTransaction` from `BasicTransaction`, or in consensus side could be used to share serialization / merkleization across consensus spec forks, e.g., for staking pools, so that their proofs whether a validator got slashed still work even if we add some more totally unrelated fields to `BeaconState` in the future. Because `StableVariant` always serializes/merkleizes as the underlying `StableContainer`, also becomes possible to do re-orderings of fields (within the variant) Will try to build https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/transaction_ssz_refactoring based on `StableVariant` as well, to see if it feels clunky. The typing overhead is the definition of the `StableContainer` that determines the field order and total number of fields available in the future.

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content:
Soo, I found some more time to work on the sugar layer on top of `StableContainer` to address the type safety concerns.

```py
# `StableContainer` determines serialization / merkelization for all variants
class Foo(StableContainer[16]):
    tick: uint64              # Determines version
    a: Optional[uint32]       # No longer used in V2
    b: Optional[uint16]       # Truly optional
    c: ByteList[4]
    d: Optional[ByteList[4]]  # Added with V2

class FooV1(StableVariant[Foo]):
    tick: uint64
    a: uint32  # Required in V1
    b: Optional[uint16]
    c: ByteList[4]

class FooV2(StableVariant[Foo]):
    tick: uint64
    b: Optional[uint16]
    d: ByteList[4]  # Re-ordering in `StableVariant` possible (sugar)
    c: ByteList[4]

class AnyFoo(OneOf[FooV1, FooV2]):
    @classmethod
    def determine_variant(cls, value: Foo, v2_tick: uint64) -> Type[StableVariant]:
        if value.tick >= v2_tick:
            return FooV2
        return FooV1
```

and, usage:

```py
value = FooV1(tick=64, a=32, b=None, c=ByteList[4]([0x42]))
encoded = value.encode_bytes()
assert encoded == bytes.fromhex("0b004000000000000000200000001000000042")

decoded = AnyFoo.decode_bytes(expected_bytes, v2_tick=42)
assert decoded == value

try:
    decoded_2 = AnyFoo.decode_bytes(expected_bytes, v2_tick=1337)
    assert False
except:
    assert True
```

Idea being, that the `StableVariant` all serialize according to the same forward and backward compatible serialization / merkleization scheme of the `StableContainer`.

Use case would be to distinguish `BlobTransaction` from `BasicTransaction`, or in consensus side could be used to share serialization / merkleization across consensus spec forks, e.g., for staking pools, so that their proofs whether a validator got slashed still work even if we add some more totally unrelated fields to `BeaconState` in the future.
